title: Probe Codex --add-dir and writable_roots; mark them unverified until then

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: S87 (landed aa7b1e5) passes --add-dir TEMP on fresh Codex write rounds and -c sandbox_workspace_write.writable_roots=[TEMP, WORKTREE] on resumed ones. docs/design.md:517-523 states both as fact, but no probe in testdata/vendors/codex covers them; the only evidence is the hand-run relay form (S74, S48). Gate later note, owner-recommended option (c): mark unverified now and add a probe.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `docs/design.md:517-523`: mark --add-dir and writable_roots *unverified* until the probe lands.
- `testdata/vendors/codex/`: a new probe (like the S89 probes) that runs a write round with --add-dir and a resumed round with writable_roots, writing one file in each temp dir.
- `internal/agent/codex/codex.go`: only if the probe shows a different flag form.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: The probe script records both writes succeeding, or the denial text; the design.md lines cite the probe file.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: The probe runs the real codex CLI by hand (the owner runs it; tests never call a real vendor). Record the transcript under testdata/vendors/codex like the earlier probes. S31's live ork run also exercises the flags; record what it showed.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: slicer check; adj lint; go test ./internal/agent/codex if the adapter changes.
